question: Should OpenClaw add a permanent public `agents.defaults.dmDirective` plus gateway directive parameter, and should it be configuration-stable for every DM turn or dynamically replaceable per turn?
rationale: The diff adds persona-overriding config and protocol surface; implementation evidence cannot determine the supported lifetime, precedence, and operator UX contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Approve session-stable DM policy
options.body: Treat the setting as a documented agent-level policy applied to every direct-chat turn and bind CLI sessions to its exact value.

options.title: Design true per-turn directives
options.body: Remove the agent-default setting and expose a narrowly authorized run-scoped input that does not persist through follow-ups, compaction, or session reuse.

options.title: Decline the new surface
options.body: Keep existing prompt mechanisms and close the feature if another permanent prompt-control contract is not worth the compatibility cost.

recommendation.title: Approve session-stable DM policy
recommendation.body: Treat the setting as a documented agent-level policy applied to every direct-chat turn and bind CLI sessions to its exact value.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision spans system-prompt, configuration, gateway, and native Codex runtime boundaries where recent integration history is strongest.
